description:
i007 (xmit-softirq-lock, snapshot s06) complete with 2 medium-confidence findings, both the exact seed shape (lock shared between process/workqueue context and softirq-reachable code, process side missing spin_lock_bh/local_bh_disable).

FINDING 1 — drivers/net/ethernet/freescale/fs_enet/fs_enet-main.c:761-768, quote 'napi_disable(&fep->napi); phy_stop(dev->phydev); spin_lock_irqsave(&fep->lock, flags); spin_lock(&fep->tx_lock);'. Lock fep->tx_lock: softirq side = fs_enet_interrupt (request_irq at :733) -> napi_schedule_prep/__napi_schedule (:344/:352) -> fs_enet_napi poll takes plain spin_lock at :99, plus fs_enet_start_xmit (ndo_start_xmit at :897) takes plain spin_lock at :523 under NET_TX softirq; process side = fs_enet_close takes the same lock plainly at :765 inside only spin_lock_irqsave(&fep->lock) — IRQs disabled, bottom halves not; zero spin_lock_bh in the file. Untrusted trigger: any packet/event running NAPI/xmit softirq plus a device close. Counter-evidence checked: napi_disable at :761 and netif_stop_queue at :758 narrow the window, but free_irq happens later (:772) so the IRQ can still schedule a fresh poll and in-flight xmit is not synchronized — residual window remains; reported medium confidence, static pairing proven, no runtime repro.

FINDING 2 — drivers/net/ethernet/sun/cassini.c:249-256, quote 'for (i = 0; i < N_TX_RINGS; i++) spin_lock_nested(&cp->tx_lock[i], i);'. Lock cp->tx_lock[]: softirq side = cas_poll NAPI poll -> cas_tx (:1927) -> cas_tx_ringN plain spin_lock at :1862 (also called directly from hardirq cas_interrupt :2562); process side = workqueue cas_reset_task (line 4005, scheduled from tx_timeout/abnormal_irq), cas_open, cas_close and link-reset take every tx_lock via cas_lock_tx (:249) under only spin_lock_irq(&cp->lock) — no BH disable, no spin_lock_bh anywhere in cassini.c. The driver's own xmit path (cas_xmit_tx_ringN :2775) uses spin_lock_irqsave, proving it knows softirq context is live. A NET_RX/NET_TX softirq on the same CPU while the reset worker holds tx_lock spins forever -> soft lockup/RCU stall/TX stall. netif_device_detach before locking narrows but does not quiesce already-scheduled NAPI polls; medium confidence.

Candidates: ks7010 seed present unpatched in s06 at ks7010_sdio.c:342 but excluded per the never-report-the-seed rule (classified safe); unresolved due to finalize deadline: altera_tse_main.c, forcedeth.c, sbni.c, cris/eth_v10.c (high plain-spin_lock density with xmit entry points, per-site attribution not completed). Limitations: static analysis only (no runtime/lockdep/compile), search bounded to s06 and to drivers/net + drivers/staging files defining ndo_start_xmit/hard_start_xmit (441 files), non-net softirq-reachable lock users not enumerated. Artifact: /mnt/raid/home/yangshuangning/vuln_variant_search/experiments/clairvoyant_variant_search/runs/10_cluster/C7/agent-state/findings/i007.json.
